description: This file contains unit tests for the class 'AmqpServiceBase'. It verifies behaviors such as client connection handling, authorization checks, link management, and disconnection events within an AMQP service implementation, using Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit for testing framework.

classes.name: AmqpServiceBaseTest
classes.description: Test class verifying the behavior of AmqpServiceBase, including connection handling, authorization, and disconnection events.

methods.name: initMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock objects needed for the tests.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates and initializes an AmqpServiceBase instance with optional endpoint and disconnect handler for testing.

methods.name: testHandleReceiverOpenForwardsToEndpoint
methods.description: Tests that the server forwards link attachment events to the registered endpoint.

methods.name: testHandleReceiverOpenRejectsUnauthorizedClient
methods.description: Verifies that the server rejects link opening from unauthorized clients.

methods.name: testServerCallsPublishEventOnClientDisconnect
methods.description: Checks that the server invokes the connection closed event handler upon client disconnection.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Creates a mock Target object representing the remote target address.

methods.name: newConnection
methods.description: Creates a mock ProtonConnection with specified user, simulating a client connection.
